dedupe_keys.name: hokkaido electric power network grid information configuration hourly flows expected flows congestion maps and outage plans

description: Hokkaido Electric Power Network, the transmission and distribution operator for Hokkaido, publishes grid information under the Agency for Natural Resources and Energy guidance on disclosure of grid information and under OCCTO arrangements. For the 187 kV and above system and for each of 24 local systems of 110 kV and below, named from Nishinakagawa to Kitananae, the page offers a grid configuration diagram, recorded power flows on transmission lines and transformers (2021 to 2025 for the bulk system, 2023 to 2025 for local systems) as zipped files, expected flows with the congestion map formerly called the available capacity map and its table, and planned outages of transmission and substation equipment for 2025 to 2027. The bulk system also has investment and retirement plans and an Excel table of equipment impedances for looped systems, and the page links to the construction plan and medium to long term congestion outlooks. Coverage is Hokkaido. Files are free to download; no licence is stated. Caveats from the page: expected flows are indicative, diagrams are schematic and do not show exact locations, recorded data may have gaps marked as missing, flows on lines serving single customers or single generating units are altered to protect third-party information, and past records may be revised without notice. Simulation uses are regional transmission network models, congestion and hosting capacity studies and outage planning. Related records: data-tohoku-nw-area-demand-supply-records covers the neighbouring Tohoku area.
